brief:
全球市场正经历一轮由"AI 交易"回撤触发的风险厌恶。周四的抛售让全球对冲基金创下疫情以来最宽的单日回撤，尽管科技股跌势在周五盘中有所缓和，油价走强仍压制了反弹情绪。布伦特原油升破 114 美元，也门胡塞武装对沙特能源设施的袭击与美伊冲突风险叠加，成为通胀预期的新变量；与此同时，Meta 因加码 AI 资本开支导致信用风险指标创历史新高，市场开始为"AI 账单"重新定价。欧洲方面，法国政治动荡令其债券风险指标逼近有记录以来最大周涨幅，财政担忧与骚乱损失同时发酵。商品与贸易层面，一艘载有俄罗斯柴油的油轮在普京与特朗普燃料协议后首次驶向美国港口，成为制裁格局变化的风向标。

1. **全球对冲基金单日回撤创疫情以来最大**：高盛主经纪业务数据显示，周四的普跌几乎波及所有策略，AI 龙头的估值压力正外溢至整个市场。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-23/hedge-funds-log-widest-daily-drawdown-since-covid-in-stock-rout) · [Reuters 报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNS0h2UUh0dUpTb1VWWGJYWm1KOXM4eXZQc1dyTlJMSWNnQ2tOVS1JRmdTMmJMaGpJSEo1c05kLUpXamZVTWVPWUppREI5OWFPUmZVV3hnektWdlRmWXVHNHpkQldJUk1PVEN0QUQ5NE0zczdSc0RMRGhOV28yYkZqeHFEMTFXUElRTDVCMXUybHRGSFhXcUFBS0hoS3V1NWVSREJGa2FCT1ludVU?oc=5)

2. **布伦特原油突破 114 美元**：沙特能源设施再遭袭击、美伊敌对风险未解，交易员在供应恢复与断供风险之间重新定价。[原文](https://www.wsj.com/world/middle-east/oil-prices-rise-as-middle-east-risks-persist-c1262364?mod=rss_worldnews)

3. **Meta 信用风险指标创纪录**：AI 资本开支计划加码推高其 CDS 水平，投资者开始质疑超大规模投入的回报周期。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxOMXV0RkI1VFVXRm4xc0tyNDBnc2NENDA3aF9XdjNxZVVGeU9IMkVlN0s0N3dvbTlYdzFFM0JwbUZjQ01tNFJpWE1GVG5wZXZjOWZMbnk1dUFrWWJlTjNrVU5kZjZxblBOUWFRX2hicTlFUEUyaTV0TjEyZUtUeHliMzZBTHFkS3BOb2FOWmF2S0RoTDBMSm1rdE84YmVQUnZ6bU9CazJmNA?oc=5)

4. **法国债券风险逼近历史最大周涨幅**：政治动荡可能加剧公共财政担忧，骚乱造成的保险损失预估已高达 12 亿欧元。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-23/french-bond-risk-nears-biggest-weekly-rise-as-crisis-deepens) · [WSJ 图表解读](https://www.wsj.com/world/europe/eight-charts-that-show-the-depth-of-frances-financial-crunch-40b31ee6?mod=rss_worldnews)

5. **普京-特朗普协议后首船俄罗斯柴油驶向美国**：油轮自普里莫尔斯克出发并间歇性标注纽约，若成行将是燃料供应协议下的首批货运。[原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-23/ship-with-russian-diesel-signals-us-port-after-trump-putin-deal) · [Reuters 独家](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxOb3Zka2dCZ1RzeXJfN1BWOGlIbHpxODVFbTdvdjFuengzUlVHTkpLVGlOa05wUXNvdWpyNl9MTGRVMTJmWFdMTTFyU3pka3FrZ0hzMGhHVEJTRGpVQXV1TEhPYXBsSjU2UllWZHlfVzBCMnBvT01NbVNUdkJiMER4YWhKZDljRUVMY2N1REdxMEpZVkg1RFhOMGFkT3NnNWljS29Jd05ZLXdNMnhmaUlUZXJWY3hGTzN4b3hEM2ExUGxNcDRLMDVr?oc=5)

items.title: BofA’s Hartnett Sees Risk-Off Mood Lasting Until Mid-November
items.summary: Investors’ risk-off mood is likely to continue well into November, according to Bank of America Corp.’s Michael Hartnett, in another sign of how jitters around the artificial intelligence trade and the US midterm elections have held back equity markets.

items.title: French Bond Risk Nears Biggest Weekly Rise as Crisis Deepens

items.title: 中东石油出口恢复至战前水平

items.title: “如同自然灾害”：保险商面临法国骚乱损失
items.summary: 晨星分析师称，上周末法国发生的暴力骚乱使保险公司面临高达12亿欧元的损失，超过2023年持续一周多的骚乱造成的逾7亿欧元损失。
